name: io.github.GeminiGeorge22/dota2-sim
title: Dota 2 Sim
description: Dota 2 simulator: right-click duel sim, build stats, EHP and DPS calculator.

tools.name: dota_hero_lookup
tools.description: FREE Dota 2 hero lookup: base stats, gains, attack. Base attributes and gains, health, mana, armor, attack damage, BAT, range, move speed and roles for a hero (name or alias like "am"). Always free. (free, no payment)

tools.name: dota_item_lookup
tools.description: FREE Dota 2 item lookup: cost, stats, components. Gold cost, stat bonuses and components of an item. Always free. (free, no payment)

tools.name: dota_build_stats
tools.description: Dota 2 build calculator: HP, armor, effective HP, DPS. Hero at a level with up to 9 items: attributes, health, mana, armor and damage reduction, magic resistance, evasion, physical and magical effective HP, damage, attack speed, attacks per second and DPS with crits (optionally vs a target armor). Costs $0.001 per call, paid with MPP on Tempo (send an MPP Payment credential in the Authorization header of the MCP request, or call POST https://dota2-sim.fmf-x402.workers.dev/mpp/dota/build-stats with mppx). Without payment it returns the price and how to pay; invalid input is never charged.

tools.name: dota_duel_sim
tools.description: Dota 2 right-click duel simulator for two builds. Seeded Monte Carlo duel between two hero builds (level + items): win probability, median time to kill and DPS each way, with pseudo-random crits and evasion. Abilities and regen not modeled. Costs $0.003 per call, paid with MPP on Tempo (send an MPP Payment credential in the Authorization header of the MCP request, or call POST https://dota2-sim.fmf-x402.workers.dev/mpp/dota/duel-sim with mppx). Without payment it returns the price and how to pay; invalid input is never charged.
